title: Claude will add official US voting information and election results
friendlyTitle: Claude will show official US voting details and results
summary: Anthropic says that later this month Claude.ai will pull state-specific voting information from Democracy Works into answers about where to vote or what identification to bring, and will show official results on election night. In a late-September sample, about 0.51% of US Claude.ai conversations were about elections or voting.
friendlySummary: Later this month, Claude will answer some US voting questions with official information, such as where to vote and what ID to bring. It will also show official results on election night.
whyItMatters: People already ask chatbots practical election questions. A sourced answer about a polling place is more useful than a model guess, but users should still confirm details with their local election office before they travel to vote.
friendlyWhyItMatters: A sourced answer is better than a guess. Still check your local election office before you rely on it.
